facts.value: One modern academic theory of religion that suggests all spiritual practice and worship follows a model similar to the Abrahamic religions as an orientation system that helps to interpret reality and define human beings.
Daniel Dubuisson, Timothy Fitzgerald, Talal Asad, Jason Ānanda Josephson
The social constructionists argue that religion is a modern concept that developed from Christianity and was then applied inappropriately to non-Western cultures.
